topic: Full Stack Capstone Integration and Testing
learningObjectives: Integrate frontend, backend, database, and UI/UX components into one application.
Validate complete user journeys across the application.
Identify and resolve integration issues before final delivery.

activities.title: Capstone Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Explore how the major components of a full stack capstone connect.

content.concept: A complete application connects the user interface to frontend logic, backend APIs, business logic, databases, authentication, and deployment infrastructure.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Defines the screens, interaction patterns, accessibility, and user experience.
Manages UI state, components, navigation, and communication with backend services.
Receives requests, validates data, applies business logic, and returns responses.
Verifies identity and controls access to protected application resources.
Stores and retrieves persistent application data.
Hosts and connects the application components in the target environment.

activities.title: User Journey Validator
activities.instruction: Arrange the complete flow for a user creating an account and using a protected feature.

content.concept: End-to-end validation checks whether a user can complete important tasks across the connected UI, frontend, backend, authentication, and database layers.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 2. React submits registration data to the API
3. Backend validates and creates the account
5. React sends authenticated request for protected data
6. Backend verifies access and reads data

activities.title: Integration Issue Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify the layer most likely responsible for each integration symptom.

content.concept: Integration problems can originate in frontend state or requests, API contracts, backend logic, database operations, authentication, or environment configuration. Debugging starts by narrowing the failure to a layer.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: The browser sends the expected API request, but the backend returns a database connection error → inspect backend/database configuration
The database query succeeds, but the browser does not update because the response is never stored in frontend state → inspect frontend state handling
config.answer: The browser sends the expected API request, but the backend returns a database connection error → inspect backend/database configuration

activities.title: Capstone Validation Builder
activities.instruction: Build a final validation plan covering the application's critical quality areas.

content.concept: A capstone validation plan should combine functional, integration, UI, accessibility, security, performance, and deployment checks for important application behavior.
